newsitem.title: MEXICO: ICA says will net $15 mln in Q3 hotel sale.
newsitem.headline: ICA says will net $15 mln in Q3 hotel sale.

text.p: Construction firm Empresas ICA Sociedad Controladora SA de CV will report an extraordinary gain of $15 million in its third quarter report due to the sale of two hotels, a company spokesman said.

"The two hotels were sold for $25.2 million, but you have to discount loans and commissions...from which net earnings are $15 million, which we shall enter under extraordinary items," the spokesman told Reuters by telephone.
The spokesman calculated that this amount would represent earnings of $0.144 per ADR, as there are 104.125 million shares in circulation. One ADR is equivalent to one nominal share.

ICA sold the two Sheraton hotels it owned at Pacific beach resorts Ixtapa and Huatulco to Circa Hotels of Dallas, Texas, as part of its strategy to disinvest in non-priority assets and to concentrate on construction and infrastructure projects.
The company now owns just one hotel, the Sheraton-Perisur in Mexico City.
